persona.label: Experience Collector
persona.description: Japan is calling, and you'd rather collect memories than things. Let's make sure your money can keep up with you.

richLifeStatement: My rich life is studying abroad in Japan and having the freedom to say yes to experiences like that, backed by credit I built myself.

goals.motivation: Studying abroad in Japan next year is the experience Maya wants most.
A credit history now gives Maya more freedom later, from apartments to travel.
Maya wants a place of her own once she graduates and starts working.

notes: Japan is 12 months out while a home is 7 years out, so the trip clearly comes first.
Credit building has no dollar target; $500 is estimated as a typical starter secured-card deposit.
The home target is an estimate for a down payment plus closing costs.
